content.value_statement: Users may forget Caveman modes, triggers, and setup options. This skill displays a compact reference card without changing mode or saving state.
actual_capabilities: Displays mode names, triggers, and behavior for Lite, Full, Ultra, and Wenyan modes.
Lists related Caveman skills and their trigger phrases.
Shows how to stop Caveman mode and return to normal responses.
Explains the default mode precedence between environment variable, config file, and full mode.
Links to the upstream Caveman documentation.
limitations: Provides help text only and does not implement compression or review logic.
Does not validate whether related Caveman skills are installed.
Does not read or modify the user configuration file.
Depends on the commands documented in the source skill.

use_cases.title: Recall Caveman Triggers
use_cases.description: Quickly view available modes and the phrases that activate each one.

use_cases.description: Share a compact reference for response style modes and related helper skills.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Configuration

prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user wants safe setup guidance.

output_examples.output: A compact card with modes, triggers, related Caveman skills, deactivation phrases, default mode notes, and the docs link.
It identifies Ultra as the most compressed mode and explains when Wenyan Ultra may apply.

output_examples.input: How do I leave caveman mode?
output_examples.output: It explains the normal-language phrases that stop Caveman responses and restore standard replies.

best_practices: Use this skill when you need the reference, then continue with the specific Caveman mode.
Treat the configuration section as guidance and make file changes yourself.
Recheck the help card after updating Caveman skills or command names.
anti_patterns: Do not expect this skill to activate or persist a Caveman mode.
Do not use it as a substitute for the full upstream documentation.
Do not assume related Caveman skills are available in every environment.

faq.question: Does this skill change my active mode?
faq.answer: No. The source instructs the assistant to display help once and not persist state.

faq.question: Can it edit my config file?
faq.answer: No. It only describes where default mode settings can live.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it include all Caveman commands?
faq.answer: It covers the modes and helper skills documented in its SKILL.md file.

faq.question: Why did the audit mention commands?
faq.answer: The file uses backticks to show command names. The skill does not execute them.

faq.question: Where can I find more details?
faq.answer: The help card points users to the Caveman project documentation on GitHub.
